race.description: Community Bank Dunkeld & District Mdn Plate
race.comment: PLATINUM RUSH (9) has been racing well without threatening. Closed in good style to be beaten just two lengths over this trip at Kyneton on Tuesday. Not much depth to this field so on the quick back-up he looks a great chance to finally break through. FIRE TYPE (3) settled midfield and couldn't improve when first-up over 1300m at Ararat last time out. Looking for this sort of trip at this stage of the prep and in a weaker maiden he comes right under notice. BIG TROUBLE (10) has been easily accounted for in her two runs to date, both over much sharper trips. By So You Think so today's journey should be much more to her liking. PRESNO (5) was game in defeat first-up over 1400m at Wycheproof recently. Sparingly raced four-year-old who has come back better than ever.
